verdict: I checked printed pages 249–254 (images 251–256), which cover the rest of the Shofar piyyut and the scriptural verses for the Shofar section. Nothing is clipped or overlapping, and nothing runs into the margins. Hebrew, including vowel points and the bold חזן cue, and English are clear and readable. The page numbers and the running head 'חזרת התפלה' alternate correctly between recto and verso. The stanza rows line up across languages on every page. Intro labels (כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ, וְנֶאֱמַר, וּבְדִבְרֵי קָדְשְׁךָ, וְעַל־יְדֵי עֲבָדֶיךָ) are paired correctly with their verses, and the Psalm 150 verses are each on their own row. This range has no notes, ending, missing-source label, or credits, so I didn't check for them. I found no blocking problems. Approved, with the two minor notes above.
